subject: Migrate endianconv.c unit tests to new test framework (#458)
reason: The change only migrates endianconv unit tests to the new test framework: it removes the SERVER_TEST-gated endianconvTest() from endianconv.c/h and adds an equivalent src/unit/test_endianconv.c registered in test_files.h. No production code path changes — memrev16/32/64 and intrev* are untouched, and the removed code was never compiled into release builds. There is no server behavior to exercise, so no scenario is needed.
